figures.caption: Table 1: Subject × Window allocations for each nominal budget.

Figure 1: Scaling-law predictions at held-out subject fractions. Columns show datasets and rows show architectures. Colours indicate subject fractions. Open markers and dotted lines show fit data (10%, 25%, 50%). Filled markers show held-out observations (75%, 100%) and solid curves their predictions. Shading: ±1 seed SD. Independent logarithmic loss scales.
Table 2: Model–task fit parameters. Training-set medians shown below datasets. RMSE calculated over hold-out set.

Figure 3: CTNet at matched volume. Low/Medium/High: window budgets. Subject/Trial: subject-/trial-heavy. Y-axes: mean test balanced accuracy ± SD. Brackets: allocations within tiers (horizontal) or adjacent tiers at Balanced (right). ∗: unpaired two-sided Mann–Whitney U, p < 0.05.
